question_text: Describe the flow of people through the venue on 2025-12-08 — how did the crowd move from gates to the expo floor to the keynote hall to the food court throughout the day? Paint a picture of the temporal flow using the data.

rubric: Morning arrivals concentrated at Gate_MainEntrance and Gate_ParkingLot around 08-10 UTC
Crowd builds on the ExpoFloor and DemoBooths during mid-morning 10-12 UTC
Keynote sessions draw large crowds to KeynoteHall_Stage at 09-10 and 14-15 UTC

answer_text: On December 8, 2025, people entered the venue primarily through Gate_MainEntrance, with 470 entries recorded between 08:00 and 12:59 UTC. From there, many attendees moved towards the KeynoteHall_DoorA, which experienced 680 entries and 685 exits between 08:00 and 15:59 UTC, indicating high activity around the keynote sessions. Throughout the day, Exhibit booths such as DemoBooth_Intel, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, and ExpoFloor_MainAisle had notable person entries and exits (169 entries and 132 exits), suggesting a steady flow onto the expo floor. The FoodCourt_North also likely saw activity, although specific entry and exit counts weren't tracked. After the keynote sessions, attendees likely dispersed towards the parking area and gates, reflected by the mix of person and car exits at the Gate_ParkingLot with 476 person exits noted until 18:59 UTC.
